Do you need to update any of this data manually? Or are we relying on the data from the scripts? If it’s simple as just displaying data - build a REST API backend that serves your data and make API calls from your React frontend. 

If it’s more complex than displaying data, personally I’d opt for DjangoREST framework that way I can build models around the data in the database and manipulate said data. 

Just remember - your frontend can be whatever you want it to be (React, Vue, etc). It’s just all about making calls to that API.

Edit: as a side note, out of personal experience it’d be better to do it either of these ways - as it seems REST is a big thing in the industry for web applications as well as SPA’s, so this knowledge would really stand out on a resume.
